title: Stalk localization for derived internal Hom of a coherent sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]), let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], let $\mathcal G$ be any $\mathcal O_X$-module, let $x\in X$, and let $i\in\mathbf Z$. Then $\mathcal H^i(R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F[0],\mathcal G[0]))_x$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] is canonically isomorphic to $H^i(R\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}(\mathcal F_x[0],\mathcal G_x[0]))$. Here $R\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}$ is the derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the one-point ringed site with structure ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$, and $H^i$ is the cohomology in its derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].
